description: This file defines the SkillsSettings SwiftUI view and related components for managing and displaying skill statuses, enabling interactions such as refresh, install, enable/disable, and environment variable management within an OpenClaw-based application.

classes.name: SkillsSettingsModel
classes.description: An observable class managing the fetches, state, and actions related to skill statuses, including refresh, installation, enabling/disabling, and environment updates.

classes.name: EnvEditorState
classes.description: Model representing the state of the environment variable editor modal.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest skills status report and updates the skills list.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation of a skill on the specified target (local or gateway).

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific skill by skill key.

methods.name: updateEnv
methods.description: Updates environment variables or API keys for skills.

methods.name: isBusy
methods.description: Checks if a skill is currently busy with an ongoing operation.

methods.name: withBusy
methods.description: Helper to set a skill as busy during an async operation.
